description: Live differential test: generate fresh inputs from a new seed (the record generator, without the cases already recorded), run them through the original and the built port, and report mismatches the recording missed. Returns the seed to replay, counts and the first mismatches; `keep` appends mismatching (or all) fresh cases to cases.jsonl so the next diff and gate check them. Works wherever record and diff do on this machine (TS/JS, Python, C, Go, Ruby, Java, Kotlin).

cases.description: Fresh cases per function (and scenarios per class) in each round (default 200).

crate.description: Folder of the generated crate (holds rust-anything.json).

keep.description: Append the mismatching fresh cases, or all of them, to cases.jsonl.

resolve_from.description: Resolve npm packages the original imports from this folder's node_modules.

seed.description: Seed of the first round; random when omitted (returned as `seed`). Later rounds count up from it.

time.description: Keep running new rounds until this many seconds have passed; one round when omitted.

name: fuzz
title: Fuzz port against original
